BiblicalUsage: Contrite is the word for a heart that has been ground to powder by its own sin and is honest about it. The Lord is near to the brokenhearted and saves those of a contrite spirit, and He promises to dwell with the humble to revive them. The same word can mean turned to dust, as man returns to the dust from which he came.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe contrition is the doorway to mercy. God does not despise the heart that knows it is dust, and He revives the very spirit the world calls ruined.
